data.desc: Caring Brands Inc. has a growing portfolio of unique, patented, and clinically validated products for skin and hair growth. The Company intends to launch a total of five products over the next two years in addition to in-licensing additional products. Management has a successful track record of strategic acquisitions, rapid product development, IP development and product licensing. Revenues from the sales of Hair Enzyme Booster for the treatment of hair loss, and Photocil for the treatment of psoriasis and vitiligo, are currently being generated by direct sales in the US and licensees in India. Additional product opportunities include CB-101 for the treatment of eczema, NoStingz, a sunscreen that prevents jellyfish stings.
